{{Short description|Spectrum of eigenvalues}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''Dirac spectrum''', named after [[Paul Dirac]], is the spectrum of [[eigenvalue]]s of a [[Dirac operator]] on a [[Riemannian manifold]] with a [[spin structure]].  The [[isospectral problem]] for the Dirac spectrum asks whether two Riemannian spin manifolds have identical spectra.  The Dirac spectrum depends on the [[spin structure]] in the sense that there exists a Riemannian manifold with two different spin structures that have different Dirac spectra.<ref>{{citation
 | last = Bär | first = Christian
 | contribution = Dependence of the Dirac spectrum on the spin structure
 | isbn = 2-85629-094-9
 | location = Paris
 | pages = 17–33
 | publisher = Société Mathématique de France
 | series = Séminaires & Congrés
 | title = Global analysis and harmonic analysis. Papers from the conference, Marseille-Luminy, France, May 1999
 | volume = 4
 | year = 2000}}</ref>
